description:
Hushfacebook v0.6.0 targets Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 (com.facebook.katana), and 577.0.0.50.72 still works.

This release gathers everything since v0.5.0 and brings 59 patches, up from 51. The new ones are Hide Meta AI questions under posts, Keep post dates, Hide post prompts, Hide reel interest prompts, Hide affiliate product links, Hide the Feeds header, Tab bar at the bottom and Start on x86 devices. The first five are on by default. Hide the Feeds header and Tab bar at the bottom go in with their switches off, and Start on x86 devices has no switch.

Saves can go to DCIM or Download as well as Movies and Pictures, or send the video's link to another app. A video opened from another app's link plays again with Tap to play on, and a picked font file reaches far more of Facebook. Material You now colours the blues that stayed in dark mode.

Validation: 1470 runtime tests passed locally. All 672 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 59 patches applied to Facebook 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

A few fixes haven't been seen on a phone yet, among them Keep post dates and the story rows between posts. Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.32.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook 580.0.0.51.74, build 475019344, or 577.0.0.50.72, build 474426275. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
